description: Source file implementing the ParsedMimeInfo class for parsing and validating MIME type strings related to media codecs, including support for audio and video codec info extraction, validation, and transfer ID mapping.

classes.name: ParsedMimeInfo
classes.description: Class for parsing, validating, and storing media MIME type information including codecs, resolution, framerate, and transfer IDs.

methods.name: SetBitrate
methods.description: Sets the bitrate for both audio and video info.

methods.name: ParseMimeInfo
methods.description: Parses the MIME type string to extract media info, validating parameters and codecs.

methods.name: ParseAudioInfo
methods.description: Parses and validates audio codec information from MIME parameters.

methods.name: ParseVideoInfo
methods.description: Parses and validates video codec information, resolution, framerate, and transfer ID.

methods.name: ResetCodecInfos
methods.description: Resets stored audio and video codec information to default invalid states.
